verdicts.reason: The current Part 2 exemplar's Order line includes the Milky Way explicitly and gives it a definite position, after first galaxies and before the Solar System. It says the Milky Way began to assemble and that its oldest stars are about 13 billion years old, roughly 800 million years after the Big Bang. This matches Lesson 2's card set, which lists first galaxies at about 300 million years and the Milky Way's oldest stars at about 13 billion years. The 'not more precise' hedge and the ~1 billion / ~200 million figures the old reviewer cites are no longer in the current text.
